features: AbleAisle is a Shopify app that runs automated checks based on WCAG 2.1 AA (using axe-core) across a store's home, collection, product, cart and information pages, and explains each issue in plain English with fix steps. A free Quick check of any Shopify store's home page is available at ableaisle.com/check without signing up.
title: AbleAisle free Shopify store check
